Seedance Prompt Labels
======================
Labels that appear at the start of lines in prompt_examples.txt.
Numbers in parentheses = occurrences across all examples (only shown when > 1).
Formats seen: "Label:", "【Label】:", "[Label]", "- Label:", and timecode prefixes.
